parameter.name: batchNumber
parameter.description: Optional lot to move (batch-tracked products). Validated against the sending facility's stock; blank = the ship auto-picks the earliest-expiry lot.

parameter.description: Optional serialNumberIds to move (serial-tracked products). When given, sets the line quantity to the count of selected serials; blank = Receive auto-relocates the first N.

actions.script: def fromGstin = fromFac?.facilityGstin def toGstin = toFac?.facilityGstin igstInvoiceId = stx.igstInvoiceId // Only an inter-state move (different STATE CODES = first 2 GSTIN digits) is a deemed supply // requiring an IGST invoice. Same-state / different-GSTIN is intra-state (CGST+SGST) — ZE-INV-IV-074. if (!(fromGstin && toGstin && fromGstin.take(2) != toGstin.take(2))) return def items = ec.entity.find("zenith.erp.inventory.StockTransferItem").condition("stockTransferId", stockTransferId).list() if (!items) return def org = stx.organizationPartyId def supState = fromFac?.gstStateCode def buyState = toFac?.gstStateCode def invId = stx.igstInvoiceId if (invId) { for (ex in ec.entity.find("mantle.account.invoice.InvoiceItem").condition("invoiceId", invId).list()) ex.delete() } else { def invOut = ec.service.sync().name("create#mantle.account.invoice.Invoice").parameters([ invoiceTypeEnumId:'InvoiceSales', statusId:'InvoiceInProcess', fromPartyId:org, toPartyId:org, invoiceDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp, description:'IGST branch-transfer invoice (' + (fromFac?.facilityName ?: stx.fromFacilityId) + ' ' + fromGstin + ' -> ' + (toFac?.facilityName ?: stx.toFacilityId) + ' ' + toGstin + ')']).call() invId = invOut.invoiceId ec.service.sync().name("update#zenith.erp.inventory.StockTransfer").parameters([stockTransferId:stockTransferId, igstInvoiceId:invId, ewayBillRequired:'Y']).call() } def totIgst = 0G; def totTaxable = 0G for (li in items) { def prod = ec.entity.find("mantle.product.Product").condition("productId", li.productId).one() def qty = (li.quantity ?: 0) as BigDecimal def unit = (li.unitAmount ?: prod?.mrpAmount ?: 0) as BigDecimal def taxable = qty.multiply(unit) def g = ec.service.sync().name("zenith.india.GstServices.calculate#Gst").parameters([ supplierStateCode: supState, buyerStateCode: buyState, gstSlabId: (prod?.gstSlabId ?: 'GST_EXEMPT'), taxableAmount: taxable]).call() def itemOut = ec.service.sync().name("mantle.account.InvoiceServices.create#InvoiceItem").parameters([ invoiceId: invId, itemTypeEnumId:'ItemProduct', productId: li.productId, description: (prod?.productName ?: li.productId), quantity: qty, amount: unit]).call() ec.service.sync().name("update#mantle.account.invoice.InvoiceItem").parameters([ invoiceId: invId, invoiceItemSeqId: itemOut.invoiceItemSeqId, hsnSacCode: prod?.hsnCode, gstSlabId: prod?.gstSlabId, igstRate: g.igstRate, igstAmount: g.igstAmount, taxableAmount: taxable]).call() totIgst += (g.igstAmount ?: 0G) totTaxable += taxable } ec.service.sync().name("update#mantle.account.invoice.Invoice").parameters([ invoiceId: invId, supplierStateCode: supState, buyerStateCode: buyState, supplierGstin: fromGstin, buyerGstin: toGstin, totalIgst: totIgst, totalTaxableAmount: totTaxable]).call() igstInvoiceId = invId
